# Hair 2 Hair Studio (H2H)

Hair 2 Hair Studio, also called H2H Hair Studio and Hair2Hair Studio, offers non-surgical hair replacement services in Telangana, India.

## Services
- Men's hair patches and non-surgical hair systems
- Women's wigs and hair toppers
- Hair extensions
- Hair bonding, fitting and maintenance consultations
- Wholesale hair products for professional buyers

## Listed physical studio locations

### Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad
Address published on the H2H website: 1st Floor, beside Sai Baba Temple, Pratap Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500060, India.
Phone published on the website: +91 81219 99243.
Location page: https://hair2hair.in/locations/dilsukhnagar/

### Khammam
Address published on the H2H website: 2nd Floor, Star Complex, near New Bus Stand, Khammam, Telangana 507002, India.
Phone published on the website: +91 81219 99243.
Location page: https://hair2hair.in/locations/khammam/
Call before travelling to confirm the exact unit and appointment availability.

## Kukatpally
H2H does not list a physical studio in Kukatpally. Customers in Kukatpally should contact H2H to confirm whether the requested service and an appointment are available at the Dilsukhnagar studio.
Information page: https://hair2hair.in/areas/kukatpally/
